normalized_outcome: Mission Control carries a source-bound Work model, effort, routing tier, triggers, Fast-mode state, and policy identity from the Chat-authored directive through authenticated admission, pre-launch enforcement, factual execution receipt, finalization, and privacy-bounded 10-task telemetry. Exact settings are either selected and truthfully verified or execution fails closed with an explicit mismatch/unverifiable state; Work cannot self-escalate.

required_outcomes.observable: One shared typed WorkExecutionProfile validates every canonical tier/model/effort combination, explicit Fast-mode state, non-empty exception triggers, and policy identity.
New Chat-authored execution directives require the profile; legacy artifacts remain explicitly LEGACY_MODEL_PROFILE_UNSPECIFIED and never receive a fabricated default.
Authenticated bounded-execution admission rejects missing/invalid new-format profiles and returns the exact authorized profile without granting spend or strategic routing authority.

The existing launch boundary enforces every settable field and truthfully records SET_AND_VERIFY, SET_ONLY, VERIFY_ONLY, or UNOBSERVABLE; mismatch and materially unverifiable profiles block execution.
required_outcomes.blocked_reason: The current Codex task-creation surface exposes model and effort setters without independent readback, exposes no Fast-mode control, and Mission Control has no callable task-creation bridge. The new preflight adapter therefore persists truthful capabilities and fails closed unless actual setter evidence and policy-required readback are supplied; active end-to-end enforcement cannot be claimed.

required_outcomes.observable: Execution receipts and finalization bind requested, authorized, observed, and final profiles; profile mismatch, required unverified fields, omitted new-format profiles, and self-escalation are rejected.

Eligible finalized Work executions feed the existing durable event/receipt persistence for the 10-task telemetry window without prompts, secrets, source text, private user data, or automatic policy mutation.
Focused and repository-required checks pass and an unmerged PR plus direct artifact bundle are delivered.

consumer_seam_acceptance: A source-bound Chat directive selecting a model/effort profile must either cause the exact profile to be selected and truthfully verified for Work execution, or the task must fail closed with an explicit unverified/mismatch state. No Work execution may silently run under a different or assumed profile.
non_satisfying_proxies: A schema-only test with no launch or finalization boundary coverage
Reusing fixed supervisor-chat consumerControls as a Work selector
Assuming a default model or effort when a legacy or current field is absent
Opening a pull request without consumer-seam mismatch and unverifiable-path evidence
Passing upstream authority tests while a runner can still launch under a different profile
hard_boundaries: Do not merge the pull request
Do not deploy or restart production services
Do not change subscription or account settings
Do not purchase credits or authorize nonzero API spend
Do not redesign routing policy or weaken Chat/Work authority
next_direct_evidence: After review and a separately authorized deployment, connect Mission Control to a structured Work task-creation surface that applies the admitted model/effort/Fast selection and independently reads the effective profile back. Until that exact consumer seam exists, new-format substantive execution remains fail closed and end-to-end enforcement remains unverified.
